preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 2000.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == n + 1 and all(p in [-1] + list(range(1, n + 1)) for p in map(int, stdin.split()[1:]))
preconditions.description: The next n lines contain integers p_i, where each p_i is either -1 or an integer between 1 and n (inclusive), representing the immediate manager of the i-th employee (1-based).

preconditions.expression: all(p != i for i, p in enumerate(map(int, stdin.split()[1:]), 1))
preconditions.description: No employee is their own immediate manager (p_i ≠ i for all i).

preconditions.expression: not any(i in [j for j in range(1, n + 1) if p[j - 1] == i] for i, p in enumerate(map(int, stdin.split()[1:]), 1))
preconditions.description: There are no managerial cycles in the input hierarchy.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the minimum number of groups required, where 1 ≤ output ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= e <= n for e in map(int, stdin.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The input employees are numbered from 1 to n.

The output is the minimum number of groups such that no group contains an employee and their superior (direct or indirect). The grouping is valid if there exists a way to partition employees into the output number of groups satisfying the constraint.
